entries.name: Files — ARM64 preview
entries.description: Project-maintained local file manager preview: browse, create, rename, move, trash and delete files.

entries.name: SSH Connect
entries.description: Project-maintained Linux and macOS ARM64 preview: searchable OpenSSH aliases and quick-connect in core-owned terminal tabs. macOS has a bounded controlled loopback authentication check; remote shells and general connectivity remain unqualified.

entries.name: Snippets — Linux, macOS and Windows ARM64 preview
entries.description: Project-maintained optional Snippets preview: search your existing YAML catalog, preview exact text, then Insert or Run. Qualified with OMXTerm 0.24.0-dev.11 on Linux ARM64, 0.24.0-dev.16 on macOS ARM64, 0.24.0-dev.30 on Linux x64 and 0.24.0-dev.36 on Windows ARM64 (exact staged Snippets plus separate FULL NSIS). Windows x64 is unqualified.
